units.rawText: In a corner of the event grounds, a girl sits with crossed legs under a banner saying "the upright discerner of truths", mumbling about something incessantly.

units.rawText: You'll only see something like this once! The great sleuth Kuro discerns all truths, with not a single dishonest bone!

spans.text: You'll only see something like this once! The great sleuth Kuro discerns all truths, with not a single dishonest bone!
